role: Introduce Ledgerloop’s scope and invite a low-friction reply
subject: Where Ledgerloop can support you
preview_text: Bookkeeping, payroll, VAT, tax, financial statements, and related work.
body:
Bookkeeping support is easier to assess when the scope is clear. You may be considering broad support or simply checking whether a particular area is covered.

Ledgerloop is a bookkeeping support service for small businesses. We handle bookkeeping, payroll, VAT, tax, financial statements, and additional accounting work, giving you a clear starting point for deciding whether a conversation may be useful.

You do not need to share detailed or sensitive financial information in your first reply. Naming the general area you are considering—or asking a bookkeeping question—is enough to begin.

We respond within one business day. That reply starts a conversation about what you need, without assuming in advance that the work is a fit.
call_to_action: Reply with an area or question
